cards.html:
The Peptide Times1902
EXTRA

The first hormone ever found was a peptide.

London 1902 · Bayliss & Starling

How does the pancreas know food arrived?

The experiment

1Cut the nerves to a loop of dog gut.
2Put weak acid inside.
3The pancreas still made juice.

The proof

No nerves needed.

Gut extract in the blood worked too: a chemical messenger.

They named it

Secretin

27 amino acids. It tells the pancreas to release bicarbonate to calm stomach acid.

1905 · Starling's new word

“hormone”

Greek for “I set in motion.”
